clue.text: Old fashioned garden in small area

yard is the American word for a garden

explanation.surface: An old-style garden squeezed into a tiny plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A square yard is a unit of measurement covering a modest patch of ground, so it is a small area.

clue.text: Sort of at risk, we participate in sport

clue.text: Contract to dispose of diamonds

clue.text: Company president going after trade with road authority!

explanation.definitionFit: A traffic cop is a police officer who enforces the rules of the road, an authority on the street.

clue.text: Centres for homemade fabrics beyond development stage

the middle two of six letters

clue.text: Bali hosts oil trade terminals - it is what it is

clue.text: Rider in elimination stage

explanation.walkthrough: 'Rider' suggests a horseman, but here it is a condition attached to a document.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider is an added proviso that limits something, and a preliminary knockout round is also called by this name.

clue.text: Note total return for old city establishment figure

explanation.walkthrough: 'establishment figure' suggests a pillar of society, but means a founder: Remus and his twin Romulus founded Rome in legend.
explanation.definitionFit: In Roman legend Remus was one of the twins who established Rome, an ancient city.

clue.text: Informed that treadle is out of order

explanation.definitionFit: To be alerted is to have been warned or told about something, so informed is a synonym.

clue.text: Jeweller provides plastic bag free

explanation.definitionFit: Peter Carl Fabergé was the Russian goldsmith famous for the jewelled eggs made for the tsars.

clue.text: Support women dumped by deceitful type

clue.text: Order to declare what to do with rotten food

definitions.text: what to do with rotten food

blocks.note: second meaning: literally eject from the mouth

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom urges someone to say something they are reluctant to, and literally means expel something from the mouth.

clue.text: One needs to be a fast mover in this mating game

clue.text: Hollywood won't listen? It's complicated

clue.text: How we might sleep some day? Just the opposite

clue.text: A queen on board in swimming costume?

the queen on a chessboard is a piece

blocks.note: the run of letters spanning the two words

clue.text: Vacated search to find this silent order?
